measure.measure_definition: Occurrence: development of persistent arthritis fulfilling the 2010 ACR/EULAR RA classification criteria during 24 months of follow-up; Participants; Clinical evaluation by participant clinicians at screening, baseline and every 3 months until the end of the 24-month study period. Primary analysis used the mFAS with failure imputation, imputing missing data on progression to RA as treatment failure.; Persistent arthritis was defined as involvement lasting more than 1 week in the same joint and fulfilling the 2010 ACR/EULAR RA classification criteria. Event time origin: randomization; follow-up 24 months. Failure imputation was applied to missing progression data in the primary analysis.
measure.measure_name: Persistent arthritis fulfilling 2010 ACR/EULAR rheumatoid arthritis classification criteria (RA development)

measure.measure_definition: Measured value: intensity of joint attacks on a 0–10 visual analog scale during the 24-month period, summarized across attacks; Attacks; Attack intensity was elicited from anamnesis at screening, baseline and every 3 months and evaluated on a visual analog scale 0–10; the source describes intensity as the degree of pain and/or functional impairment. The pre-randomization reference interval was the 6 months before randomization. The 24-month summary is the median (P25, P75) across attacks with information; Fig. 4b reports 793 attacks in the abatacept group and 706 in the hydroxychloroquine group.; VAS scale 0–10. The reported period-level summary is median (P25, P75) intensity across attacks with information during the 24-month period; baseline reference is the 6 months before randomization. Attack-level denominators are distinct from participant denominators.
measure.measure_name: Intensity of palindromic joint attacks on a visual analog scale

measure.measure_definition: Occurrence: remission of palindromic rheumatism symptoms during the 24-month period; Participants; Assessed at study visits every 3 months from baseline through 24 months.; Remission defined as no or a single palindromic attack during at least four consecutive visits (that is, 12 months) during the 24-month period.

Planned treatment duration 24 months.

population.population_definition: All 73 randomized participants: 37 assigned to abatacept and 36 to hydroxychloroquine; three assigned abatacept did not receive allocated treatment.
